title: Tests share one global in-memory DB with no per-test reset (order-dependent)
evidence: router_test.go:15 setupTestDB() sets BOOKAPI_DB then calls initDB(); db.go:12 initDB() short-circuits on the package global `db`, so the shared-cache DB is opened once and reused across TestHealth/TestCRUD/TestListByAuthor with no cleanup. TestCRUD (router_test.go:74) asserts `len(list) != 1`, which only holds because it happens to run on an empty DB in the current order.
suggestion: Reset the DB between tests (drop/recreate the table or null the global `db` in setup) so assertions are not order-dependent.

title: initDB kills the process with log.Fatalf on DB errors
evidence: db.go:23 and db.go:36 call log.Fatalf on sql.Open / CREATE TABLE failures, so a transient DB error terminates the whole server instead of returning an error the handler can surface as 500.
suggestion: Return an error from initDB and handle it at startup; have getDB()/handlers propagate it as an HTTP 500.

title: year/isbn use omitempty so zero values are dropped from JSON
evidence: router.go:16-17 Book.Year and Book.ISBN carry `omitempty`, so a book with year 0 or empty isbn omits those keys in responses; harmless for the spec but slightly inconsistent output shape.
suggestion: Drop omitempty on Year/ISBN if a stable response schema is desired.
